title: Ring Doorbell Not Working?
5 Fixes to Try First
sub: Offline, no alerts or no live view
safety: Use your Ring app and the manual for your model.
Wired doorbells: turn the breaker off before touching any wiring.
Save any recordings you want before a factory reset.

steps.title: Reconnect from the Ring app
steps.body: Open the doorbell's Device Health page, then try Reconnect (or Reboot) under Network.

steps.title: Check the power
steps.body: Battery model: charge it fully. Wired model: check for loose or damaged wires and a working transformer.

steps.title: Check the Wi-Fi signal
steps.body: Device Health shows signal strength. If it's weak, move the router closer or add a Wi-Fi extender. 2.4 GHz reaches farther.

steps.title: Restart your router and modem
steps.body: Unplug both for 30 seconds, plug them back in, and give the doorbell a few minutes to reconnect.

steps.title: Reset and set it up again
steps.body: Still offline? Factory reset the doorbell, then use Set Up a Device in the Ring app. Still stuck? Contact Ring support.
